heading: Career background
intro: Experience across advisory work, transactions and dispute resolution.

roles.title: Principal consultant
roles.summary: Leads an independent consulting practice advising private clients and businesses on transactions, disputes and regulatory matters, from first consultation to resolution.
highlights: Advises businesses on contracts, governance and compliance
Represents clients in negotiation, mediation and formal proceedings
Drafts and reviews agreements, policies and legal opinions
Provides discreet counsel on family and succession matters

roles.title: Senior associate
roles.summary: Managed a broad portfolio of client matters, supervised junior colleagues and worked alongside partners on complex instructions.
highlights: Managed matters from intake to closure
Prepared pleadings, opinions and transaction documents
Carried out legal research and due diligence

roles.title: Associate and legal officer
roles.summary: Built a foundation in legal practice across advisory work and litigation support.
highlights: Assisted with case preparation, research and drafting
Attended hearings, client meetings and negotiations
Maintained case files and regulatory filings
